description.zh:
仓库类型，取值：

- `PUBLIC`：公开仓库

- `PRIVATE`：私有仓库
description.en:
The repository type. Valid values:

- `PUBLIC`: public repository

- `PRIVATE`: private repository.

description.zh:
镜像tag不可变性，取值：

- `true`：开启

- `false`：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether image tag immutability is enabled. Valid values:

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-repository --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --repo-id crr-tquyps22md8p0000 --repo-type PUBLIC --summary test_repo --detail repo-for-test --tag-immutability true --repo-namespace-name ejiayou-other --repo-name dsp/domain-microapp --region cn-hangzhou
